data.title: Schools are starting to teach AI literacy. For many, that means helping kids see chatbots' flaws
data.description: AI chatbots have become the bane of teachers everywhere. But a growing number of U.S. public schools are now encouraging a new strategy: Bringing AI into the classroom, partly so students can see its shortcomings.
